🌎 Welcome to Build World!

🏡 Build your dream home, create a mighty castle, or design an entire city!
🛠️ Let your imagination lead the way—your world starts with one block!
💾 Save your creations in FREE private servers!

What will YOU create? 👀

👍 Love building? Like the game and ⭐ Favorite to come back for more!
